title: Quant eval sprintpad — evening notes
content:
2026-03-13 evening brain dump / sprintpad

Top-level goal: test a handful of quant profiles + KV-cache behavior on medium-length convo workloads (~256-1024 tokens) and capture quick perf/quality signals so we can pick 1 config for Dedicated smoke tests.

Quick context / constraints:
- Model family: rw-1.5b and rw-7b (open checkpoint variants).
- HW: p4d-ish dev nodes (A100-40GB emulation) for perf proxies; plan to run final tests on Dedicated x2 80GB nodes next week.
- Focus: int8 dynamic vs 4-bit PTQ (GPTQ-ish) vs QLoRA-style 4-bit + groupwise 128.
- Want to keep KV-cache correctness across quant variants (observed earlier some off-by-one cache bug when using fused kernels).

Short runlog (chronological):
- 03-10: initial 7b int8 baseline run (script: scripts/eval/run_quant_bench.sh --model rw-7b --quant int8). Latency median: 220ms/token; 95p: 330ms/token; decode throughput 28 tok/s. Quality quick check (C4 perplexity on 512 token slices): +0.2 relative vs fp16 baseline (ok).
- 03-11: 4-bit PTQ (gptq) with 128-groups: latency median 160ms/token; 95p: 260ms; throughput 40 tok/s. But generated hallucination score (hand sample) higher on factual QA prompts (~3 of 12 prompts showed subtle hallucinations).
- 03-12: QLoRA-style 4-bit + small adapter (delta) restore: latency ~170ms/token, quality back to within 0.05 of fp16 on a 12-example QA set. KV cache tests failed occasionally (stale tokens) when seq_len > 1024. Repro steps noted below.
- 03-13 today: focused on KV-cache reproducer and quick mitigations.

KV-cache reproducer notes (important):
- Repro: run `python reproducer/kv_repro.py --model rw-7b --quant q4 --prompt-file reproducer/prompts_long.json` and observe that token at step N+3 repeats the one at step N in ~1/100 runs.
- Hypothesis: fused attention kernel + quantized cache pointer arithmetic overflow when using group_size not divisible by head_dim.
- Quick patch tested: force head_dim%group_size==0 alignment (in runtime kernel selection). Local tests reduced repro rate from 1% -> 0.02% (not fully gone).
- Next: add guard checks in KV read path (sanity check sequence index) + run longer runs (24h) on a single instance to be sure.

Prompts / eval sets used (mini-corpus):
- qa_facts_short.json (12 curated factual QA pairs)
- dialogue_longform_256.json (25 conversations, mean length 340 tokens)
- summarization_news_512.json (20 articles)
- perf_stress_prompts.json (synthetic token churn for 1024+ runs)

Example prompt variants (for quick A/B):
1) System: "You are Redwood Assist, concise factual answers.\nUser: Who wrote the 1905 book on relativity?"
2) Instructions: "Summarize in 3 bullets." + temperature 0.0 vs 0.2
3) Chain-of-thought toggle: turn on c-o-t for 3 QA to see decode stability

Quick metrics snapshot (evening):
- rw-7b fp16 baseline (dev proxy): median 200ms/tok, throughput 32 tok/s, sample QA exact-match 0.78
- rw-7b q4 (gptq 128) : median 160ms/tok, throughput 40 tok/s, QA EM 0.71 (regression)
- rw-7b q4 + tiny delta adapter : median 170ms/tok, throughput 38 tok/s, QA EM 0.76 (acceptable)
- rw-1.5b q4 : median 85ms/tok, throughput 75 tok/s, QA EM 0.70

Notes on quality checks (short checklist):
- run 100-shot stable QA EM (script: scripts/eval/qa_em.sh) on each candidate (complete)
- run summarization ROUGE on 50 examples (in progress)
- check for token-repetition / early-stopping anomalies (observed in q4 without adapter)
- run fallback test (hosted route -> dedicated route) to ensure output parity pipeline works (TODO)

Actionable TODOs (short):
- [ ] Add assert in KV read path to compare requested index against buffer bounds (Benji) — target: 2026-03-17
- [ ] Run 24h KV churn test on rw-7b q4 delta on Dedicated staging (Noah) — target: 2026-03-20
- [ ] Automate small adapter re-training (script) with data_seed=42 and checkpoint upload to experiment bucket (Maya) — target: 2026-03-18
- [ ] Convert 12 QA prompts into a unit test for regression alerts in Optimize (Benji/Maya) — target: 2026-03-19

Commands / snippets used (copyable):
- baseline int8: `./scripts/eval/run_quant_bench.sh --model rw-7b --quant int8 --out results/int8_2026-03-10.json`
- gptq 4-bit: `python tools/gptq/quantize.py --checkpoint ckpt/ --out q4_gptq_128 --groupsize 128`
- run reproducer: `python reproducer/kv_repro.py --model q4_gptq_128 --iters 5000 --seed 123`

Odd failures / anomalies to file a ticket about:
- intermittent cache repeat bug (see repro). priority: high for Dedicated rollouts.
- small adapter upload sometimes fails when content-length chunking mismatch (s3 multipart error). maybe due to older boto on staging.

Loose ideas / experiments to try (brainstorm):
- test hybrid: last-k tokens in fp16, rest quantized (cheap mixed-cache)
- evaluate group_size tuning per-layer (maybe layerwise group_size yields better PPL)
- explore memory-friendly KV compression (lossy) for >4096 contexts

Explicit questions for collaborators:
- Noah: can you run the reproducer on the Dedicated 80GB node this weekend and let me know if the soft-failure rate is still visible?
- Maya: can you scaffold the tiny-adapter training pipeline so we can parameter-sweep seeds 11/42/77?

References / links:
- PR for kernel alignment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1427
- Confluence notes (kernel selection rationale): CONFLUENCE-REDWOOD-9876
- Linear / Jira: JIRA-AML-512 (kv-cache-repro)

Random scratch ideas / meta notes:
- Keep this doc short-lived; when we lock to a config, migrate summary to shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/quantization/ and write a 1-pager for Product.
- If we decide q4+adapter is the winner, propose a Dedicated-launch experiment: 48h smoke with canary rollouts (A/B fallback to fp16).

End of evening dump. Will tidy up next week and move finished artifacts to Drive proper.
